Generates C headers and source files for metric metadata, enums, and tile metric tables.

# Purpose
This file generates C header and source files from a metrics model. It converts metric, tile, and enum names into macro and array names, then writes definitions for offsets, names, types, descriptions, converters, and histogram limits. The code also builds per-tile metric tables, shared metric tables, and enum metadata files under the `generated` directory. Its scope is narrow: it is a code generation script for metrics definitions, not a runtime metrics library.
